courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Basic Clinical Embryology
courses.description:
The aim of this module is to provide basic knowledge on human embryology from fertilization through birth. It includes:
1. The mammalian reproductive system
2. Gametogenesis
3. Fertilisation and Early embryogenesis
4. Embryonic Development of special systems
5. Congenital malformations
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Advanced Clinical Embryology

meetings.instructor:
Professor CHAN Yiu Leung, 
Professor CHUNG Pui Wah Jacqueline

courses.description: This course allows students to have a highly advanced theoretical and practical understanding of human embryology. It helps student to understand more the applied aspects of clinical embryology. And, it help students to have a comprehensive overview of all aspects of the ART Laboratory, including the set-up and running of the laboratory, specific procedures, and quality control to ensure the highest possible success rates in an IVF program
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Andrology
courses.description:
This course provides a knowledge set appropriate for the broad range of health care professionals involved in the treatment of the infertile male, provide training in the assessement of parameters of male reproductive function, and assist professionals in identifying strategies for the treatment of male infertility. The course includes:
1. The physiology and pathophysiology of male reproductive function
2. Key elements of the male factor evaluation
3. Basic and advanced testing of reproductive function
4. Surgical and nonsurgical treatments of male infertility
5. Strategies for male fertility preservation
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Clinical Issues and Controversies in ART

meetings.instructor:
Professor CHAN Yiu Leung, 
Professor CHUNG Pui Wah Jacqueline

courses.description:
In this course, the latest opinion and controversies in ART field (including both clinical part and lab part) will be reviewed and discussed.
It includes the latest opinion and controversies in:
1. ART diagnosis
2. ART treatment
3. ART technology
4. The latest guidelines and opinions in the ART world
5. The latest regulation and law in the ART world
6. The latest opinion regarding ART Ethics

Assessment: Debate
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Infertility and IVF Clinical Counseling
courses.description:
This course allows students to gain an understanding of the complex issues of infertility, modern fertility treatment, as well as current management strategies for infertile couples. It includes:
1. Definition and diagnosis of infertility
2. Treatment strategies of infertility
3. Patient support and counselling
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
Students are expected to:
a. Acquire basic knowledge on the medical and counselling aspects of reproductive medicine;
b. Develop counselling skills and techniques through hands-on experience; and
c. Build a peer support network.

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: IVF Equipment: Selection, Application and Maintenance
courses.description: The course will introduce the students how to select the suitable equipment according to the need of their laboratories, the maintenance and the related regulations. The equipment includes microscope and micromanipulation system, incubators, CASA and vitrification system. Hands-on workshop will be provided to the students during the lesson.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes: The students should be able to select, use and maintain the IVF laboratory equipment including microscopes, micromanipulation system and lazer, incubators, CASA and vitrification system.

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Preparatory Course for International Examination in Clinical Embryology
courses.description: The course will include lectures and discussions on basic science and techniques relating to Human Reproductive Biology. In addition, full ESHRE (European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology) Embryology exam syllabus will be covered.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes: The students are expected to be well-prepared to sit for ESHRE examination to achieve the certification of clinical embryologists at the end of the course.

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Genetics in Reproductive Medicine

meetings.instructor:
Professor CHAN Yiu Leung, 
Professor CHUNG Pui Wah Jacqueline

courses.description:
Reproductive genetics is an increasing part of the assisted reproductive technology (ART) practice. Daily, ART centers use genetic information when couples undergo ethnicity screening, when donors are screened and chosen for recipient couples, to determine the cause of infertility or recurrent pregnancy loss, and when utilizing preimplantation genetic screening (PGS) and preimplantation genetic diagnosis (PGD). However, the application of genetic information and genetic testing is often limited due to lack of knowledge by the medical providers in the ART practice.

This course serves to provide basic to complex genetic information to help such practices start to fill this education gap and competently apply genetic information to improve patient care.

It includes:
1. Both basic genetics education and review of real time application.
2. The faculty will address current knowledge of the genetic causes of infertility
3. The latest research on and testing for infertility treatment and diagnosis
4. The gamete donor and gestation carrier screening
5. The PGD in clinical application
6. The latest information about PGS
7. The latest technology and its applications
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Reproductive Medicine & Assisted Reproductive Technology – Overview
courses.description:
This course allows students to gain an overall picture of ART, including basic conception, definition, basic clinical procedure, basic lab procedure, as well as the most updated knowledge and technology. It includes:
1. The development of ART history
2. The components of ART team
3. The basic procedures and responsibility of each ART components
4. Communication of each components
5. Definition and diagnosis of infertility
6. Treatment strategies of infertility
7. Patient support and counselling

Assessment: written examination
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
Students are expected to:
1. Understand the ART history and current technology development
2. Acquire the basic conception of Reproductive medicine and ART
3. Acquire basic knowledge on the ART treatment
4. Understand the whole procedure of ART in current clinical practice

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Reproductive Medicine & Assisted Reproductive Technology - Clinical
courses.description:
This course allows students to gain detail knowledge and basic information about the modern ART treatment, infertility complex issues, as well as current management strategies for infertile patients.
It includes:
1. Investigation of infertility
2. Treatment strategies of infertility
3. Ovulation induction
4. In vitro fertilization in a clinical IVF lab
5. Complications of ART (e.g. ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome)
6. Counseling of infertile complex issues
7. Patient support
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
Learning outcome
The students are expected to have knowledge and understand:
1. Infertility investigation
2. Infertility diagnosis
3. Infertility treatment strategies
4. The principle and strategy of ovulation induction
5. Basic procedure of oocyte retrieval
6. Basic procedure of embryo transfer
7. The strategy in counseling infertile patients
8. How to handle complications of ART treatment in clinical

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Cell Biology and Molecular Biology
courses.description:
The aim of this module is to quickly review the reproductive medicine related basic knowledge of cell biology and molecular biology, as well as the most update related knowledge. It includes:
1. The cell structure and cell organelles
2. The cell physiological properties
3. The cell metabolic processes and signaling pathway
4. The cell cycles
5. The structure and function of DNA, RNA and protein
6. The processes of replication, transcription and translation
7. The techniques of molecular biology
8. The interactions between cell and their environment

Assessment: written examination
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
The students are expected to acquire the basic and updated knowledge on:
1. Cell biology and molecular biology of the Cell
2. Modern techniques of cell biology and molecular biology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: IVF Laboratory Management and Communication
courses.description:
This course serves to provide basic knowledge and skills on IVF laboratory management, and the communication both inside and outside of the laboratory.
It includes:
1. IVF lab procedure management
2. IVF lab quality control and risk management
3. IVF lab trouble shooting
4. Communication inside of the lab
5. Communication outside of the lab

Assessment: written examination
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
At the conclusion of the course, students should be able to understand:
1. The principle of procedure management
2. The basic requirement of QC/QA system in an IVF lab
3. The principle of risk management
4. The principle of trouble shooting in an IVF lab
5. The principle of communication inside/outside of the lab

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Research Methodology
courses.description:
This course facilitates students to use statistics to carry out their research projects adequately.
It includes:
1. Basic research methodology
2. Basic statistical concepts
3. Research process and encourages an appreciation of why and how research is generated

Assessment: Written Examination
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
Students are expected to be able to:
1. understand basic concepts of research and its methodologies
2. identify the components of a literature review process
3. identify the types of research methods best suited for investigating different types of problems and questions
4. develop research questions that based on and build upon a critical appraisal of existing research
5. understand basic statistical concepts
6. design a research proposal
7. be aware of the ethical principles of research, ethical challenges and approval process

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: IVF Laboratory Design
courses.description:
This course gives students a chance to understand very basic requirement of designing a modern IVF laboratory.
It includes:
1. The basic conception of “clean room”
2. The basic requirement of IVF lab designing
3. The trend of IVF lab design

Assessment: design an IVF lab
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes:
The students are expected to have knowledge and understand:
1. International requirement for an IVF lab design
2. The difference between a “sterile operation room” and a IVF laboratory
3. The key points of IVF laboratory design

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Research Project
courses.description:
Research topics related to reproductive medicine and clinical embryology will be provided. The students are required to perform research work related to thesis topic under direction of their assigned supervisors, who are the principal investigators and senior academic staffs from the Chinese University of Hong Kong.

The research project will either be a laboratory-based or clinical data-based investigation. Students are required to write up the result in a dissertation.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology

courses.subject: RMCE
courses.title: Clinical Attachment
courses.description:
It will be clinic-based and laboratory-based attachment, students are required to attach to:
A. Clinic-based Attachment
1. Gynaecological out-patient clinic for infertility and gynae-endocrinological case management.
2. Gynaecological operative theater for infertility surgical management.
3. Assisted Reproductive Unit for cycle monitoring, ovarian stimulation, oocyte retrieval, embryo transfer, intrauterine insemination.

B. Laboratory-based attachment
Students will perform to followings by using the materials donated for teaching purpose after obtaining patient informed written consent.
1. Semen analysis.
2. Sperm preparation.
3. Gametes handling
4. Embryo culture
5. Micromanipulation
6. Crypreservation of gametes and embryos
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Reproductive Medicine and Clinical Embryology
courses.learning_outcomes: The clinical laboratory attachment will provide an environment for the students to undertake practical laboratory training. After the training, they are expected to understand different practical techniques and processes related to reproductive medicine and at the same time consolidate their working knowledge. It will be beneficial to the students to get the hands-on experience needed for a laboratory-based career and also improve their communication skills required in the workplace.
